Date: Mon, 05 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Scheduling: demo for FinCo SSO / calendar integration

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the quick response on Friday. We’d like to get a 45min demo scheduled next week that includes our IT lead (Bob Li) and a PM (Sarah Nguyen). We have folks across PST and CEST so two points we need help with:

- Timezone stitching: one attendee will be joining from London (CEST) and sometimes invites get converted incorrectly in our system.
- Join permissions: our company blocks Google Meet links added by external senders (the calendar strips the join URL).

I accepted the invite you sent but when I click the join link it tries to open meet.google.com and fails due to our policy. Can you either send an invite from a Zoom link (preferred) or provide an alternate join URL that won’t be stripped?

I attached our SSO/calendar integration requirements so you can see the constraints.

Proposed window: Wednesday 3pm PT / Thursday 00:00 CEST or Thursday 10am PT / Friday 19:00 CEST. Either works for us if you can confirm the join method.

Thanks,
Alice Li
Head of Integrations, FinCo
alice.li@finco.com

Hi Alice,

Appreciate the details and the doc. Sorry you hit a Meet blockade  that happens with strict GSuite policies.

Short plan:
1) I can resend the event with a Zoom join URL and include an ICS that references the Zoom join directly (helps if your calendar respects the event owner’s join link).
2) Ben will create the Zoom meeting (we can disable waiting room and add passcode if you prefer).
3) I’ll also add Sarah and Bob as required attendees so the invite originates from our domain but includes their addresses — that usually prevents the link from being stripped.

Which slot is best for you: Wednesday 2025-05-14 15:00 PT or Thursday 2025-05-15 10:00 PT? Please confirm and I’ll send a fresh invite with the Zoom link and an attached demo brief.

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt

Thanks Hannah.

Either slot is OK but the earlier one is preferable. Couple of clarifications:
- Our calendar admin has previously stripped meeting links that are in the event body but kept links present in the "location" or the "conferenceData" fields when the invite is authored by a known vendor.
- We cannot receive Meet links added by external addresses; Zoom is fine.

If you can create the Zoom meeting and send the invite with the Zoom conference metadata (not just a URL in the body), that should work. Also please explicitly include Bob (bob.li@finco.com) and Sarah (s.nguyen@finco.com) as required attendees.

Appreciate it,
Alice
